R38.2 regression: bare opaque code. The code appears once in a long doc, so hash-embedding cosine stays under the 0.2 floor (like a real embedder's no-signal direction) and the summary carries no code tokens, so only the keyword leg fires. Fused must still hit via the keyword floor.
Second R38.2 pin: the postmortem's other unique all-caps code, same floor-only signature.
